name: The Green House
address: The Green House, Clara, Co. Offaly
agent: Hilary Hamill, Sherry FitzGerald Lewis Hamill
bedsNote: 5 on the first floor, 1 in the attic storey
heating: Oil-fired central heating, stove in living room
tagline: A c.1792 Georgian house on 0.83 acres with a walled garden and stone outbuildings, overlooking the green in Clara, Co. Offaly.

pros.text: Direct train to Heuston from the town
pros.detail: Clara station is on the Galway line; the fastest trains take about 59 minutes to Heuston.
On the green in a town of about 3,400: shops, pharmacies, GP, library, swimming pool.
St Francis NS 510 m (190 pupils), Clara Convent NS 730 m (183).
Inside the 140–280 m² target, with large rooms (7 m sitting and living rooms).
Close to the acre the dogs want, walled, with two stone outbuildings.
Midland Regional Hospital Tullamore has a 24-hour ED, about 12 km; Mullingar is the second option.
Shutters, cornicing and fireplaces kept; described as well presented, mains services.

cons.detail: All bedrooms are upstairs and the one bathroom is on the first floor. The sitting room (7.0 × 4.2 m) could become a bedroom, but a ground-floor shower room would have to be added.
€130k above the ideal; it only fits the 'special, near a train' allowance. Stamp duty about €6,300.
Expect to add at least one more; rough €15–30k each.
A 1792 house will be cold and costly to heat; retrofit options are limited in period fabric.
Listed June 2025 with 15,000+ views; ask why, and use it in negotiation.

cons.text: Development land next door in the pitch
cons.detail: Lapsed permission for four houses on the site; check what neighbours might build and whether the garden stays intact.
